header.description: Integration of the FiveM server with the Discord of {guild}.

config.ttlRange: TTL must be between 1 and 60 minutes.
config.title: Module settings
config.subtitle: Applies to all API keys on this server.

altAccounts.label: Allow alternate accounts
altAccounts.description: When on, one Discord account can link several FiveM licenses on the server. Default is 1 Discord ↔ 1 license.

ttl.label: Link code lifetime
ttl.hint: How long the player has between connecting to FiveM and running {command} on Discord. 1 to 60.

linkPanel.label: Link panel
linkPanel.description: Posts a message with the {button} button: the player clicks it, pastes the code shown when joining FiveM and that's it, no need for {command}. Posting again replaces the previous panel.

preview.note: Preview of the FiveM connection screen. Data (code, position) are examples.

customization.httpsRequired: Image and invite URLs must be https.
customization.saved: Customization saved. Applies on the server in ~1 min.
customization.title: Card appearance
customization.subtitle: Images, color and texts of the linking, queue and role cards. Applies on the server in ~1 min, no restart needed.
customization.imageHttps: The image URL must be https (use the upload if you don't have one).

color.label: Accent color
color.hint: Color of the buttons and highlights on the cards.

invite.label: Discord invite
invite.hint: "Open Discord" button on the cards. Empty = hides the button.

default.label: Default
default.hint: A section with status, capacity bar, map and game mode.

embed.label: Classic embed
embed.hint: Name/value fields you configure, with inline (side by side). Same as txAdmin.

components_v2.hint: Container with blocks and the layout editor. No inline, everything stacked.

statusPanel.title: Status Panel
statusPanel.intro: Persistent Discord panel showing the FiveM server status in real time (online/offline, players, banner + Join button). The bot updates it automatically.
statusPanel.noKeys: Add a server in "Settings" before creating panels. Its cfx ID is configured there.
statusPanel.empty: No panels yet. Click "New panel" to create the first one.
statusPanel.autoDisabled: Auto-disabled, the bot lost access to the channel. Restore the permissions and re-enable it.
statusPanel.noCfxId: The selected API key has no cfxServerId configured.
statusPanel.incompleteField: Field {index}: fill in name and value (or remove the field).
statusPanel.deleteDescription: The Discord message is removed too.
statusPanel.formatHint: Side-by-side (inline) fields only exist in the classic embed; Components V2 stacks everything.
statusPanel.formatChanged: Switching format republishes the message on save; Discord does not allow converting an already posted message. The old one is deleted and a new one is sent in the same channel.
statusPanel.layoutHint: Choose a ready-made template. It applies until you build your own layout in the editor below.
statusPanel.ownDesignWins: This panel has its own layout built below, which overrides the template. Use "Back to template" to drop the editor.
statusPanel.ownLayoutHint: Build your own and use "+ Field" for live values; the bot fills them on every update.
statusPanel.joinAlwaysAdded: The "Join server" button is always added at the end; it belongs to the panel, not the layout.

keyCard.weightsInvalid: Weights must be integers between 0 and 100.
keyCard.disconnectDescription: The installed server loses its connection to Discord immediately: linking, allowlist and queue stop. To reconnect, download the folder and install it again.

install.title: Install on the server
install.step1: Download the folder and put {folder} in the server resources.
install.step2: Add {command} to {file} and start the server.
install.hint: It connects by itself on the first start and shows up here as connected. There is no key to copy. Each download is good for one installation: to switch machines, download again and the previous one is removed automatically.

allowlist.title: Role allowlist
allowlist.subtitle: entry gate
allowlist.toggleAria: Turn the role allowlist on or off
allowlist.offHint: Allowlist off: any {linked} player gets in, with no role or Discord presence check.
allowlist.hint: The player needs {atLeastOne} of these roles. Leave empty to allow any Discord member.

mode.title: API failure mode
mode.permissiveHint: If the backend does not respond, the player {action}.

queue.title: Weighted queue
queue.subtitle: priority when the server is full
queue.toggleAria: Turn the role priority queue on or off
queue.offHint: Queue off: everyone gets in with equal priority (order of arrival). The server manages slots natively.
queue.hint: Effective weight = {sum} of the player's roles. Roles without weight count as 0 and get in last.

server.title: FiveM server
server.subtitle: identifies this server for the Status Panel
server.endpointHint: When set, direct polling overrides CFX (fallback).
server.endpointInvalid: serverEndpoint must be "ip:port" or a URL.

installState.waitingLine: Downloaded, waiting for the first server start
installState.notInstalledLine: Download the folder and install it on the server

actions.imported: {count, plural, one {# action imported.} other {# actions imported.}}
actions.missingTarget: Enter the action and the target.
actions.sent: Command sent, track its progress in the Deliveries tab.
actions.mappingHint: Each action points to an event (TriggerEvent), an export or a console command of your gamemode.
actions.garagesKnown: Suggestions from the garages in use on your server. Each action can use another one through the "garage" variable.
actions.garagesUnknown: Once the updated resource runs, your server's garages show up here as suggestions.
actions.lockDescription: Give money, items, jobs and vehicles in game from the panel and from store sales.
actions.emptyHint: Start with the money, item, job, gang, revive and vehicle actions. They work with QBCore, Qbox and ESX, with the mri-botcreator resource updated on the server.
actions.commandHint: Runs in the server console. Use {id} for the player's server ID, {license}, {discord} and the action variables.
actions.presetsHint: A starting point for the most common gamemodes. After importing, edit the event and variables as you like; the preset is not tied to anything.
actions.presetExists: An action with this key already exists.
actions.sendHint: Triggers a gamemode action on the target player. PRO feature.

activity.subtitle: Chronological event feed: connect, link, queue, admit, deny, drop, error.
activity.empty: No events recorded yet. When a player connects, the flow events show up here.

status.off: Off, players download directly from the server.
status.verifying: Waiting for the server to confirm the address (up to 1 minute with the server running).
status.active: Active, players download through the CDN.
status.watchdogOff: The CDN did not respond and the server went back to direct download. It turns back on by itself when the CDN returns.
status.pending: On in the panel; waiting for the server to apply it (up to 1 minute).

cdn.intro1: With the CDN on, players download the server resources from Cloudflare's edge instead of your server's link. The first player for each file fetches it from the server; the following ones get it from the cache.
cdn.intro2: If the CDN goes down, the MRI resource notices within 30 s and hands the download back to the server by itself. MRI being down does not affect servers that already have the CDN applied.
cdn.unavailable: The resource CDN is not available on the platform yet.
cdn.proLock: The resource CDN is part of the Pro plan.
cdn.noServers: No game servers registered. Add one in Settings.
cdn.savedOn: Saved. The server applies it within 1 minute.
cdn.savedOff: CDN off. The server goes back to direct download within 1 minute.
cdn.purgeDescription: The next players will fetch the files from the server once again.
cdn.purged: Cache cleared ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}).
cdn.toggle: Turn on the CDN for this server
cdn.hostHint: This is the address the internet uses to reach the FiveM port (the same one players use). Before turning it on, MRI checks that this address really is your server.
cdn.hostChanged: Changing the address repeats this check.
cdn.aceHint: Without them the resource cannot turn the CDN on or off, and the panel shows "missing permissions".

queue.title: Resolved queue
queue.hint: Top 10 members sorted by effective weight (sum of the weights of the roles each one has). Shows who would get in first if the server filled up now.
queue.noKey: No active API key to calculate with.
queue.error: Bot offline or without permission to read members.
queue.empty: No members with a weighted role. Set weights on the roles below to see the ranking.

preview.empty: Add a server to see the preview.

servers.added: Server added. Now just download and install it.
servers.title: Servers
servers.addHint: Each server has its own download and its own configuration. Use one for the live server and another for testing.
servers.emptyTitle: Connect your FiveM server to Discord
servers.emptyHint: Add the server, download the folder and put it on your server. It connects by itself on the first start: there is no key to copy.

kpi.uptimeFailures: {count, plural, one {# check failed} other {# checks failed}}

chart.title: Connections in the last 24h
chart.subtitle: Attempts verified by the API, all keys combined.

keys.title: Status by key
keys.subtitle: Each connected FiveM server and its volume today.
keys.empty: No servers yet. Add one in Settings.

queue.title: Live queue
queue.subtitle: Players waiting to join in the last 15 minutes, sorted by weight.
queue.empty: Nobody in the queue right now.

links.unlinkDescription: Removes the link for {who} (license …{license}). They will have to link again to join the server.
links.title: Links ({count})
links.subtitle: Linked Discord ↔ FiveM accounts. Unlinking forces the player to link again.

logSession.opened: Session open for {minutes} min. The server starts sending on the next cycle (up to 1 min).
logSession.closed: {count, plural, one {Session closed, # line deleted.} other {Session closed, # lines deleted.}}
logSession.title: Live diagnostics
logSession.hint: Turns on server log forwarding for a limited time. The level here {strong}; it stays at its own level. Lines are deleted when you stop, and in any case after 24h.
logSession.hintStrong: does not change the owner's console
logSession.waiting: session open, waiting for the server to send (up to 1 min for the first batch)…
logSession.empty: no lines. Start a session to see the server log here.

logs.subtitle: Errors reported by the backend (5xx) and by Lua (via /error). The 50 most recent.

moderation.aceLoadError: Could not load the server's groups.
moderation.nickSaveError: Could not save. Check that the pattern is a valid regex.
moderation.aceInvalid: "{principal}" is not a valid group. Use something like group.admin (no spaces or quotes).

nick.title: Nickname while in game
nick.intro: Renames the member on Discord while they are connected. The evaluated text is {input}, and the pattern groups become {g1}, {g2}, the same format used in Discord Admin.
nick.resetOnLeave: Restore the original nickname when leaving the server
nick.limitation: The bot cannot rename the server owner or anyone with a role above its own; it's a Discord limitation, and in those cases the nickname simply does not change.

ace.title: Discord role → in-game permission
ace.intro: Whoever has the role gets the ACE group while online and loses it when leaving. Promoting someone on Discord takes effect on the server without editing {file}, and the change applies immediately, without the player reconnecting.
ace.noServers: No FiveM servers yet. Add one in Settings.

staff.label: Staff chat channel
staff.hint: The conversation becomes the same on both sides: {command} in game shows up here, and what is written here shows up for the staff who are playing. Whoever has the {group} group can use it; map a role above to grant it.

bans.title: Active bans
bans.empty: No active bans. Use {command} on Discord.

ops.title: Latest operations
ops.empty: No operations yet. Use {command} on Discord.

strictMode.label: Strict mode
strictMode.hint: A backend outage refuses the connection instead of letting it through.

linkPollSeconds.label: Link check interval
linkPollSeconds.hint: How often the server asks whether the player has linked.

linkTimeoutMinutes.label: Link timeout
linkTimeoutMinutes.hint: How long the player has to link before being disconnected.

noRoleKickAfterSec.label: Wait for role before disconnecting
noRoleKickAfterSec.hint: How long a player without the role stays on the "Awaiting role" card.

cardHeartbeatSeconds.label: Card heartbeat
cardHeartbeatSeconds.hint: Redraws the card even without changes, so the screen does not revert to text.

cardDeferImages.label: First card without image
cardDeferImages.hint: The card paints immediately and the logo/banner come in on the next render. Turn it off only if the images are on a fast CDN.

cardConfigRefreshSeconds.label: Fetch panel config every
cardConfigRefreshSeconds.hint: Also sets how long a change on this screen takes to reach the server.

opPollSeconds.label: Admin ops interval
opPollSeconds.hint: This is the latency between staff pressing enter on Discord and the action happening.

anonCommand.label: Anonymous message command
anonCommand.hint: Without the slash. Renaming takes effect immediately; the old name points the player to the new one until the next restart.

logLevel.label: Log level
logLevel.hint: Shows up in the server console. In production, "info".

resourceConfig.loadError: Could not load the resource config.
resourceConfig.saved: Config sent, the server applies it on the next cycle (up to 1 min).
resourceConfig.restored: Restored: the server goes back to using its own config.lua.
resourceConfig.title: Resource config
resourceConfig.hint: Overrides the server's {file} and applies {noRestart}. Empty field = the server uses the value from its own file.
